{"result":"{\"id\": \"page_qa_runbook\", \"space_id\": \"space_ENG\", \"parent_id\": \"page_eng_home\", \"title\": \"QA Regression Runbook\", \"body\": \"

Manual QA regression pass run against every release candidate before we submit a build for review. Owned by QA (Vincent Parker); anyone cutting a build can run it, but a green matrix here is a gate on the Release Checklist & Store Submission. Scope covers Domino Delights (internal codename GoD, \\\"Game of Dominoes\\\"), Zombie Match 3D (listed as \\\"Puzzles vs Zombies\\\" until the July 2025 rename). Budget a few hours per title - the first five chapters alone run over an hour; if something fails, file the bug and block the release, don't hand-wave it.

Test the UPDATE path, not just a fresh install. The June 2025 progression losses were on Domino Delights, and nobody ever reproduced them - the leading hypothesis was the update path, which is why we test it. Every candidate must be installed over the last two shipped versions and checked for save/progression loss before we ship. If we only test fresh installs we will miss this entire class of bug again.

Recurring bug classes to always check

These four have all bitten us in production. Treat them as non-negotiable checks on every pass, on real devices, not just the emulator.

  • Font / asset download stall on splash. In May 2025 Domino Delights froze at roughly 22% on the splash screen while pulling remote fonts and assets (ENG-2346, build 0.2.197). Watch the loading bar all the way to gameplay; test on a throttled/slow connection and with the app cache cleared.
  • Lives & scheduler regeneration. Confirm lives tick back up on the timer, refill correctly after device clock changes, and that offline time is credited without over-granting.
  • Quest population & reset. New quests populate on a fresh session, complete correctly, and roll over at the daily/weekly reset without duplicating or leaving empty slots.
  • Save / progression integrity. Level, coins and unlocks survive an update, a force-quit and a re-launch. This is the one the June 2025 wipe belongs to.

Regression matrix

Run each row on at least one iOS and one Android device. Both update rows are mandatory - N-1 and N-2 are the last two shipped store versions.

AreaFresh installUpdate from N-1Update from N-2Notes
Splash / asset loadPassPassPassWatch for the ~22% stall (May 2025 Domino Delights)
Save / progressionPassPassPassJune 2025 wipe never reproduced in-house; update path is the leading hypothesis
Lives & schedulerPassPassPassTest with device clock changes
Quests populate / resetPassPassPassCheck daily + weekly rollover
Purchase / restorePassPassPassSandbox account. NOTE: entitlements do not restore on reinstall and receipts are not validated server-side - see the per-title IAP row below. Check the purchase grants client-side, not that it restores.

If a check fails

  • File the bug with device, OS version, source build and repro steps, and link it here.
  • A failure in any UPDATE column blocks the release - fresh-install-only regressions do not pass the gate.
  • Player-facing symptoms (lost progress, stuck splash, missing lives) should be mirrored to the Customer Support Playbook so support has a known-issue note before it hits the store.

Once the matrix is green, tick the QA sign-off on the Release Checklist & Store Submission before submitting to the stores.

Per-title regression matrix

Each release candidate is walked through the full matrix below on at least one iOS and one Android device. A cell fails the gate if the observed behaviour deviates from the expected column; file the bug, mark the matrix red, and block the submission.

\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n\\n
AreaCheckExpectedDominoZM3D
First-time UXFresh install \\u2192 tutorial \\u2192 first winNo stall; tutorial completes; first level winnableYesYes
Font / localisationCold start on a fresh device (no cached font)UI renders; no blank/boxed glyphs at ~22% loadYesYes
ProgressionPlay 3 levels, force-quit, relaunchLevel and currency persist; no reset to level 1YesYes
EconomyEarn + spend coins, buy a boosterBalances reconcile; booster consumed once.YesYes
Live-opsEnter the active event; complete a questEvent loads; quest ticks; rewards grantedYesYes
IAPSandbox purchase + restoreItem is granted client-side and purchases cannot be restored on reinstall. Receipts are effectively NOT validated: Domino Delights' Node backend exposes a POST /validate-receipt route, but it is dead scaffolding - validateReceipt() is never defined or imported, it logs undefined variables (bodyRequest, packId), and on success it grants nothing and returns undefined. Zombie Match 3D has no such route at all. Treat the route's existence as a trap: do not assume verification because an endpoint is there.YesYes
AdsWatch a rewarded ad to completionReward granted once; no double-grant on retryYesn/a
\\n

Known-issue regression cases

These are the incidents that have bitten us in production; every one now has a permanent regression case so it cannot silently return. Reproduce the trigger, confirm the fix holds.

\\n

Font-download stall. On a fresh device the dynamic font pack could fail to download, freezing the UI at ~22% of the splash-screen load (this is a position on the loading bar, not a share of players). Regression: install on a wiped device with a throttled connection; confirm a fallback font renders and load continues.

\\n

Progression reset. Returning players were once dropped back to level 1 with their player id unchanged in Metabase; the cause has not been established. Regression: migrate a save across a reinstall; reinstall with a LINKED Apple/Google account and confirm the server profile rehydrates. Quest-chest progression is known not to survive this (ENG-2114); unlinked guest accounts cannot be recovered at all.

\\n

Quest not resetting / not populating. A bad deploy left the daily quest board empty. Regression: roll the clock across a UTC day boundary; confirm quests repopulate and completion state resets.

\\n

Device lab

The minimum matrix is one recent + one old device per platform. We keep a small physical lab plus a cloud device farm for the long tail.

\\n\\n\\n
PlatformRecentOld / min-specTablet
iOScurrent-gen iPhone, latest OSiPhone SE-class, oldest supported OSiPad (one gen)
Androidcurrent-gen Samsung / Pixellow-RAM device, oldest supported OSone Android tablet
\\n

Sign-off

QA posts the completed matrix in #god-bugs (Domino Delights) or #zombie-bugs (ZM3D) and links it from the release ticket. A build without a green matrix should not get submitted. In practice Friday is the usual release day and builds have shipped without a completed pass - QA has asked for a Friday freeze but it has not been adopted.

{"documentId": "f_6d0326fa006b136f1bbf82", "title": "ZM builds and QA passes", "name": "ZM builds and QA passes", "revisionId": "0bb86f7514", "createdTime": "2025-09-12T22:21:36Z", "modifiedTime": "2025-09-12T22:29:41Z", "text": "ZM builds and QA passes

Internal, Android and Submission are only the jobs. What matters is the branch. For ZM a QA pass only counts on a build of the main branch. A build of a feature branch is for the dev to check their own work, so a pass there has to be done again once the branch is merged.

If you want QA to look at a branch build before you merge, that is fine and it saves time, just don't call it passed.

A pass stands until somebody sees the bug again on a main build made after the one it passed on. Then it is open again, whoever saw it.

Which branch a build came from is in its #builds post.
"}

Fix #465 is in main (merged 25 Sep). The 'ok, chat' was on iOS Internal #1718, a QueueManager branch build, so it doesn't count. Not re-tested on a main build yet.
Card upgrade tutorial never shows after the Zombie Lane one
Fix #465 is in main (merged 25 Sep). The 'ok, chat' was on iOS Internal #1718, a QueueManager branch build, so it doesn't count. Not re-tested on a main build yet.
Quest tutorial arrow points at the wrong tab after the last panel closes
nr on iOS Internal #1745 (main). Not seen on a later main build.
Win streak tutorial at level 20 freezes the home screen
No fix in main, no re-test.
Coin animation plays again after killing and reopening the app
Fix #465. ok on iOS Internal #1745 (main). Not seen on a later main build.
Level-end coins fly while the pre-level panel is already open
Fix in main through #472 ('holds the pre-level panel until the level-end coins have landed'), merged 30 Sep. QA has not tried it on a main build yet.
Reward count-up is skipped when tapping fast on play
nr on iOS Internal #1745 (main). Not seen on a later main build.
Stars from the level fly to the wrong corner on tablets
No fix in main, no re-test.
Season pass popup comes up on top of the daily gift when both are due
nr on iOS Internal #1745 (main), but Vincent saw it again on Android Submission #135 (main, later build). Pass reopened, no fix in main.
Daily gift calendar opens before the level-end coins finish
Still there on Android #2013 (main). No fix in main since then.
Daily gift day counter keeps going after a skipped day
Already ticketed as ZOM-556. No fix in main, no re-test.
Season pass icon animation restarts every time a panel closes
Fix #472 in main (merged 30 Sep). Not re-tested on a main build yet.
Season pass start popup shows again after every level until it is claimed
No fix in main, no re-test.
Season pass reward claim animation plays twice when coming back from the shop
No fix in main, no re-test.
Event bar starts filling while the daily gift popup is still open
Fix #472 in main (merged 30 Sep). Not re-tested on a main build yet.
Endless unlock banner shows again after coming back from a level
No fix in main, no re-test.
Reward animation waits too long before the event bar fills
ok on iOS Internal #1757 (main), but Samuel saw it again on Android Submission #135 (main, later build). The #472 fix was already tried on main.
Event panel opens over the level-end rewards on first unlock
The 'again' on Android #2013 was before #472 merged into main (30 Sep). QA has not tried a main build with the fix.
Event progress popup opens before the level-end coins finish
Fix only exists locally (Owen), nothing in main.
Win streak freezer from the abandoned pack never shows up on the home screen
Already ticketed as ZOM-560. No fix in main.
Streak counter jumps by two after a win when other panels are waiting
No fix in main, no re-test.
Zombie Lane reward animation plays under the home buttons
nr on Android #2006 (main). Not seen on a later main build.
Zombie Lane panel opens twice after claiming
ok on Android #2006 (main). Not seen on a later main build.
Lane progress bar animates from zero every time
nr on iOS Internal #1757 (main), but Owen saw it again on Android Submission #135 (main, later build). No fix in main.
Boss arena tutorial does not play when another tutorial is queued before it
Fix #465 is in main. The 'ok, chat' was on iOS Internal #1718 (branch), so it doesn't count. Not re-tested on a main build yet.
Boss arena unlock popup shows behind the level-end rewards
nr on Android #2006 (main). Not seen on a later main build.
Arena entry button can be tapped during the reward animation
nr on iOS Internal #1745 (main). The later sighting was on Android #2006, a main build made before #1745, so the pass stands.
Endless unlock banner overlaps the daily gift
No fix in main, no re-test.
Coming back from Endless replays the home intro animation
ok on iOS Internal #1750 (main), but it was seen again on Android Submission #135 (main, later build). Pass reopened, no fix in main.
Endless reward chest opens before the coins land
No fix in main, no re-test.
Tap to collect prompt is missing when a pack opens after a level
Fix #475. ok on iOS Internal #1757 (main, after the merge). Not seen on a later main build.
Pack opening sound keeps playing on the home screen after the pack closes
Fix #475 in main (merged 30 Sep). Not re-tested on a main build yet.
Last pack does not show its cards before closing
Fix #475. ok on iOS Internal #1757 (main, after the merge). Not seen on a later main build.
Pack count on the home button only updates after a restart
Fix #475 is in main, but it's still there on iOS Internal #1757 (main).
Tutorial hand stays on screen after the last panel closes
nr on iOS Internal #1745 (main). Not seen on a later main build.
Level-end rewards do not show at all right after an app update
No fix in main, no re-test.
Win streak freezer popup opens behind the season pass popup
No fix in main, no re-test.
Pass progress bar fills before the tokens arrive
No fix in main, no re-test.
Season pass icon glow stays on after everything is claimed
Not on the flow sheet. Marcus reported it in a DM on 30 Sep, seen on that day's main build. No fix in main.

I've set up everything Brian asked for and sent him the numbers in your DM. My first message said five passes came back when it was four, so I sent a one-line correction right after; the numbers didn't change.

**The numbers sent to Brian**

| | Count |
|---|---|
| Reports passed | 10 |
| Waiting on QA | 8 |
| Waiting on a fix | 21 |
| Areas clear | 0 of 10 |
| Reports on the review list | 7 (Collect & Win 4, Level-end rewards 3) |

That's 39 reports: Vincent's 38 flow pass rows plus one from a DM. Marcus told you on Sep 30 that the season pass icon glow stays on after everything is claimed. I kept the skip-tutorial exceptions and the input blocker off, as Brian asked.

**What's set up**
- **Linear:** ZOM-543 now has 10 area children (ZOM-587 to ZOM-596), all Todo because none is clear. 22 existing tickets moved under them, each with a note giving its status and why. 17 new sub-issues (ZOM-597 to ZOM-613) for reports that had no ticket, with no priority and no assignee. Two existing tickets changed state: ZOM-568 to In Validation and ZOM-585 back to Todo.
- **Sheet:** "ZM Queue Manager stock-take" is in your ZM queue manager folder, with the Reports and Areas tabs Brian specified. It's shared as view-only with Brian, Leonard, Arthur, Julia and Vincent.
- **Slide:** one slide with the five numbers, added at the end of your ZM queue manager deck.

**Calls Brian may question**
- **Branch-build passes don't count.** Arthur's rule only counts QA passes on main-branch builds. Vincent's "ok, chat" on the two tutorial rows and the Boss Arena tutorial was on iOS Internal #1718, a QueueManager branch build, so those are waiting on QA rather than passed.
- **Four passes reopened.** People saw these bugs again on Android Submission #135, a later main build:
  - season pass popup over the daily gift
  - the Endless intro replaying
  - the Collect & Win reward delay (ZOM-585)
  - the Zombie Lane progress bar (ZOM-586)
- **One pass kept.** Someone tapped the arena entry button during the reward animation on Android #2006, but that build is older than the build it passed on, so the pass stands.
- **ZOM-568 counts as waiting on QA** even though Vincent's sheet lists no fix. PR #472 says it holds the pre-level panel until the coins land.
- **Existing tickets reused.** ZOM-556 and ZOM-560 already covered rows 11 and 20, so I moved them instead of opening duplicates.
- **Review agenda.** The review list follows the agenda on Leonard's roadmap card (Collect & Win and Level-end rewards). That replaced the "Collect & Win and Daily Gift first" Brian mentioned in your DM on Sep 29.
